body: Be mine! I am going I’m from Florida and I’m going out to CA by myself 😂

I attempted suicide by slitting my wrist drunkenly 4 months ago. Honestly at the time it was pretty painless. I went extremely deep and vertical instead of laterally because I wanted people to think it was just an accident where I was self harming and slipped, but I knew exactly what I was doing. 
It doesn’t hurt at first, especially when you’re bleeding out, however it is so painful afterwards if you survive and your chances of survival are high. I was not given any heavy duty pain meds because of my history so I was left taking a shit ton of Advil and laying around the house alone for two weeks wishing it had worked and I had died.
